name: 中央の値を読む目標リング
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Create one isolated Japanese Lighthouse goal-ring component LH17-0003 中央の値を読む目標リング. Square composition approx210x210 logical px, crisp enlarged raster on pure white #FFFFFF, compact and aligned. No added dashboard or controls.
Reference hierarchy: Image1 ORIGINAL Fitbit image is primary for ring geometry, optical weight, circular smoothness and fine detail. Image2 native mock is secondary for Japanese adaptation and its explicit120/150 demonstration values. Official white/forest-green/slate design and Meiryo typography remain binding. Image3 approved Lighthouse bus direction is only a style reference for restrained depth and forest-green gradient; do not import bus content.
Source observed: thick turquoise circular goal visualization around a centered value, with clear distinction between value and goal. Our mock translates this to participation,120 of150; the exact source's12018of10000 and its extra overflow are not these adapted values. Preserve the mock's120/150 as80% progress. Keep a precise circular ring,80% clockwise from12o'clock to roughly9:36, with remaining20% in a quiet neutral gray track. Smooth constant ring thickness, clean endpoints matching the visible native80% adaptation; do not show100% or120% completion. Center is pure white, replacing rejected broad mint fill. The ring uses a subtle forest-green gradient #174C36 to #1F6444 to #2D8F5E with no gloss or glow. No additional accent hue because there is one meaningful progress quantity. A light neutral track communicates remaining work without color-only ambiguity: numbers120and150 remain readable.
Inside ring, exactly three centered lines, verbatim: 参加の目標 / 120 / 目標 150. Preserve Meiryo: small supporting text12/16 regular, central120bold20/28, zero tracking. Values and label dark neutral, supplementary goal subdued readable gray. Ensure labels have generous breathing room inside ring and remain fully visible. Keep all ring edges on canvas. No icon: this catalog component explicitly excludes the source'sfootprint/device artwork and is a number-only ring. Do not invent icon, percentage, checkmark, new label, button, logo, watermark or data. No mint circle, no colored card backdrop. Apple Design clarity, purpose, careful type hierarchy and restrained material. Static image candidate only.
reviewNotes: 原画の円環形状を優先、日本語説明用データ120/150=80%を維持。ティールから森林緑に適応、白中心・中立の未達成20%を確認。生成を目視し、参加の目標と目標150が指定のMeiryo Regular12/16より太く大きく見える。中央120の強さは妥当。補足2行の太さ・大きさを限定修正する。所有者承認・ネイティブ編集可能性・実装未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
